question: Which of the following teams won the first edition of ISL (Indian Super League)?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Atletico de Kolkata**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The** first edition **of the **Indian Super League (ISL) was held in 2014.**
 
• The **team that won the tournament was Atletico de Kolkata (now known as ATK), defeating Kerala Blasters FC in the final by a score of 1-0.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **The tournament was a professional football league in India, **consisting of** eight teams from different cities in India**.
 
• It was played in a **round-robin format, followed by a knockout stage with the top four teams qualifying for the semifinals and then the final.**
 
• The tournament had a total of 61 matches played over** 72 days, with the final taking place on December 20, 2014, in Mumbai.**
 
• **Atletico de Kolkata** emerged as the champions of the **first edition, defeating Kerala Blasters FC 1-0 in the final, with Mohammed Rafique scoring the decisive goal in the dying minutes of the game.**
 
• The first edition of the** ISL was widely regarded as a success, with a total attendance of over 1.5 million fans, and it helped to raise the profile of football in India.**
